context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical hydration bug is fully resolved on the preview URL by running `next start` (production) instead of `next dev`. Any regressions to the runner (e.g., reverting to `next dev` or Turbopack streaming through the ingress) would re-break client hydration on preview. Keep the defense-in-depth method='post' + type='submit' on admin-login and FinanceEnquiryForm regardless.
rca of the issue: Root cause of iteration_1's CRITICAL hydration bug: Next.js 16 Turbopack dev mode streams the RSC-flight/HTML payload; the Emergent ingress + FastAPI reverse-proxy chain did not preserve that streaming correctly, so the browser closed the read before react-server-dom-turbopack chunks resolved, and React silently bailed on hydration. With no client-side listeners, forms fell back to native browser submission (default method=GET) which pushed credentials + PII into URLs. Fix applied by main agent: switched preview runner to `next start` (pre-built production bundle — no dev streaming). Verified in this iteration: form has react fiber keys attached, POST XHR fires as intended, navigation is client-side, no plaintext-in-URL leaks in access log since restart.
